resources.string: An affirmation, a thought, the date and how far along the year is.
A quiet start to the day.
A quiet end to the day.
Write one in your own words…
Lines you keep come back roughly one morning in four. Tap Keep this one above when something lands.
After this hour the card changes to a different set of words — setting down, noticing what went well, permission to stop. It stays that way until 4am.
Colours follow the time of day
Indigo at dawn, cooler through the middle of the day, rose at dusk, deepest at night. Turn this off to keep the dawn palette all day.
Home screen: press and hold an empty spot, tap Widgets, find Daily Light, drag it where you want it.

On One UI 8.5 and newer: press and hold the lock screen, tap the pencil, then Widgets, and add Daily Light there too. On older versions Samsung only allows its own widgets on the lock screen — this one will appear there after you update.
On the widget, tap the words to draw a different pairing and tap the date to come back here. Reshuffling lasts the day; tomorrow returns to its own words.
